intent.outcome: mp manages CHANGELOG.md via CLI commands - show, add, edit, init, and auto-generate a version section from milestones completed since the last release - keeping it consistent with the release map.

problem.description: CHANGELOG.md is hand-maintained. There is no mp command to view, add, edit, or scaffold it, and no way to auto-generate a version section from completed milestones. Each release requires a human to transcribe milestone/WP summaries into the changelog by hand, duplicating data already in the plan and risking drift between what shipped and what the changelog says.

in_scope: `mp changelog show` (optionally --version / --section) - print CHANGELOG.md or a slice
`mp changelog add <entry> --version <ver> --section <section> [--milestone <id>]` - insert an entry under the right version/section, creating the version header if absent
`mp changelog edit` - structured edit / open the file
`mp changelog init` - scaffold a Keep a Changelog-style CHANGELOG.md if absent

`mp changelog generate --version <ver>` - assemble a version section from milestones completed since the last shipped release, grouped by milestone/WP, reading target_version from the release map (M36); matches existing CHANGELOG.md conventions
Integration tests: add creates/positions entries idempotently; generate matches a fixture; show slices by version
out_of_scope: Publishing changelog entries to GitHub/Gitea releases (distribution, not editing)
Retroactive rewriting of historical entries (generate is forward-looking)
AI-prose generation - entries derived from milestone titles/intents, not generated prose

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp changelog show` prints CHANGELOG.md; `--version <ver>` slices one version section
acceptance_criteria.verification: show + slice test on a fixture changelog

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp changelog add` inserts an entry under the correct version+section, creating the version header if missing, without duplicating existing entries
`mp changelog init` scaffolds a Keep-a-Changelog-style file when none exists
acceptance_criteria.verification: init test in a temp dir asserting the scaffold

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp changelog generate --version <ver>` builds a section from milestones completed since the last shipped release, grouped by milestone/WP, matching the existing CHANGELOG.md style
acceptance_criteria.verification: generate test against a fixture plan with completed milestones + release map
